points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 93e8729 clean CMake build passes with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench with two CPUs and 3 GiB; no CFD rerun. Curated report cannot compile without excluded figures.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:17–41,65–105 parses case/output/restart and reads rank-local restart; transient restart does not restore previous BDF state/time.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates mesh, partition, fluxes, solver, driver and output; solver.cpp is large and remains 2-D perfect-gas specific.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected fluxes.cpp, solver.cpp, driver.cpp and partition/halo implementations; no affirmative copied-core or executable-wrapper evidence, without exhaustive external-authorship search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:89 reads configured CGNS path and partition.cpp calls METIS; run controls and physics come from case input rather than a two-filename branch.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Neighbor halo/reductions and METIS exist, but main.cpp:89–119 retains complete mesh on every rank through solve; report.tex:401–407 claims the opposite.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Re200 relaxed inner acceptance is counted as target convergence; plateau checks drag but not lift. Several cases terminate with small residual reductions and Re20 lift drifts.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Original validator passes eight case structures; clean build now passes. No new CFD rerun, smooth-order study, or reproducible committed report figures.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Separated components and detailed comments; large solver/driver sources include numerous environment-controlled behaviors and warnings.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
